verdict.rationale: The browser configuration docs offer a first-class local mode (`localBrowser.launch`) alongside Browserbase, plus attaching over CDP to any Chromium already running on your machine (`localBrowser.connect`). The local user-data-directory docs confirm local sessions keep cookies and storage between runs. missing for 10: explicit documentation that local mode needs no Browserbase or other cloud account (server-side caching hints at cloud dependencies for some features), and independent or hands-on corroboration of local-only development.
